decisions.reason: Floor-level shower drainage is the core of the firm's announced direction toward accessible, low-profile bathrooms, and the investment in this line calls for persistence even though it has not been visible on the website since 2019.
The designer shower drain was publicly presented as the flagship of the firm's design-focused strategy, so the sunk investment and visible commitment make a withdrawal very unlikely.

The shower element with integrated slope fits the integrated, low-profile system strategy, and weak results can still be blamed on pandemic-related disruption in construction rather than on the product itself.

The backflow-protected basement drain had a dedicated page and a specific launch announcement, so this public commitment and the steady renovation demand for flood protection argue for keeping it despite its weaker link to the bathroom focus.
